items.name: Finder
items.summary: A "packed pair" finder that uses 256-bit vector operations.

methods.name: find
methods.summary: Execute a search using AVX2 vectors and routines.

methods.name: find_prefilter
methods.summary: Run this finder on the given haystack as a prefilter.

methods.name: is_available
methods.summary: Returns true when this implementation is available in the current environment.

methods.name: min_haystack_len
methods.summary: Returns the minimum haystack length that this `Finder` can search.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new pair searcher. The searcher returned can either report exact matches of `needle` or act as a prefilter and report candidate positions of `needle`.

methods.name: pair
methods.summary: Returns the pair of offsets (into the needle) used to check as a predicate before confirming whether a needle exists at a particular position.

methods.name: with_pair
methods.summary: Create a new "packed pair" finder using the pair of bytes given.
